title: Dose Tracker
migrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS medications (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, dose_interval_hours REAL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))) STRICT
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS doses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, medication_id INTEGER NOT NULL, taken_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))) STRICT
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

queries.updateMedication: UPDATE medications SET name = :name, dose_interval_hours = :doseIntervalHours WHERE id = :id
queries.listMedications: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.dose_interval_hours, m.created_at, (SELECT taken_at FROM doses WHERE medication_id = m.id ORDER BY taken_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_dose_at FROM medications m ORDER BY m.name ASC

searchMedications.sql: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.dose_interval_hours, m.created_at, (SELECT taken_at FROM doses WHERE medication_id = m.id ORDER BY taken_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_dose_at FROM medications m WHERE 1=1 {{filters}} ORDER BY m.name ASC

queries.updateDose: UPDATE doses SET taken_at = :takenAt WHERE id = :id
queries.listDoses: SELECT id, medication_id, taken_at, created_at FROM doses WHERE medication_id = :medicationId ORDER BY taken_at DESC LIMIT 50
queries.getMedication: SELECT id, name, dose_interval_hours, created_at FROM medications WHERE id = :id
queries.getSetting: SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = :key
queries.setSetting: INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (:key, :value) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = :value
